title: @ycforge/pilot plugin-registry — .ycsf/builders.yaml schema and BRG_* error code catalog
description: Machine-readable contract for the Project C builder/materializer registry (spec 013): JSON Schema for the .ycsf/builders.yaml file (requiring version: 1), the PluginRegistry/PluginEntry/PluginLoadError runtime shapes, and the catalog of BRG_* validation, load and model-validation error codes.

buildersYaml.title: .ycsf/builders.yaml entry
buildersYaml.description: Explicit mapping of builder/materializer identifiers to plugin import specifiers (Constitution V: explicit over magic, one source of truth).

builders.description: Map identifier → builder package import specifier.

materializers.description: Map identifier → materializer package import specifier.

buildersYaml.description: builders and materializers key sets MUST NOT overlap (BRG_KEY_COLLISION). Both maps optional; empty file with only version:1 is a valid empty registry.

pluginEntry.title: One successfully loaded and recognized registry entry

packageName.description: Import specifier (npm package path/name, or fixture path in tests).

module.description: Loaded module exporting Builder or Materializer (spec 002).

records.description: identifier → PluginEntry; one entry per unique identifier.

diagnostic.title: Registry / validation diagnostic
diagnostic.description: Reuses the project-model diagnostic shape (code/message/file + optional app/field/line/column) for registry structural errors and BRG_UNKNOWN_BUILDER model validation.

errorCodes.title: BRG_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: All builder-registry validation, load and model-validation error codes (spec 013). Distinct BRG_* family, separate from PML_* project-model codes. Compared via constants, never string literals (Constitution V).

BRG_VERSION.description: Missing or invalid version:1 in builders.yaml (FR-002).

BRG_DUPLICATE_KEY.description: Duplicate key within builders or materializers section (FR-003, uniqueKeys).

BRG_KEY_COLLISION.description: Same identifier in both builders and materializers (FR-003, Constitution V).

BRG_INVALID.description: Invalid builders.yaml shape: non-string/empty value, empty key, bad top-level structure (FR-004).

BRG_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND.description: Dynamic import failed: module not found / not resolvable (FR-009).

BRG_NOT_A_PLUGIN.description: Module loaded but does not export a Builder or Materializer shape (FR-010).

BRG_LOAD_ERROR.description: Other import() error during module evaluation, e.g. syntax/runtime (FR-011).

BRG_UNKNOWN_BUILDER.description: App.builder identifier is absent from the registry (FR-013); carries app_id and available builders.
